response.sql: WITH acc AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_amt, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_bal FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), reg AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_amt) AS avg_amount, AVG(avg_bal) AS avg_balance FROM acc GROUP BY region), fin AS (SELECT region, avg_amount, avg_balance, AVG(avg_amount) OVER () AS overall_mean FROM reg) SELECT region, avg_amount, avg_balance, avg_amount / overall_mean AS ratio_to_overall_mean FROM fin WHERE overall_mean IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: Transactions of other types (e.g. VYBER) are excluded from the amount average but still included in the balance average, as the request says 'all of the account's transactions' for balance.
Accounts whose transactions are all of other types have a NULL amount average and are skipped by the regional AVG; regions with a NULL amount average are skipped in the overall mean.
The overall mean is the plain average of the regional average-amount values (one per region), not an average over accounts or transactions.
